decisionsTitle: Five more clauses in the race declaration, and the electronic signature's trace
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-14, after a SportID «Consimțământ electronic» he received for a trail race:** «DA» to both halves, and, the same hour, «YOLO»: the open points below were decided without asking. Amends §568 (the risks and the waiver of the race declaration: five more clauses), §418 (the signed PDF, the privacy notice's declaration paragraph, the counsel's review), §330 (the minor's own signature), §754's notice paragraph, §758 and §768 (the volunteer agreement and its guardian) and §769 (a minor signs a group run's declaration beside a parent), and AGENTS.md §10.8 («no raw IP/user-agent stored by default»).

**A. Five clauses and one sentence in the race declaration's TEMPLATE** (`templates/declaration.ts`, the trail's text and the road's, Romanian and English; written once, among the shared duties, in the owner's order, between «fair-play» and «obiectele personale»): (1) valid medical insurance for incidents during the event, or the medical costs borne in full; (2) the marked route followed and the organiser's and the volunteers' instructions respected, the organiser being able to stop or disqualify («voluntari», never «arbitri»); (3) disqualification without appeal, «în limitele permise de lege», for leaving the marked route, unsporting behaviour or breaking the event's rules or the declaration; (4) litter in the event's area a ground of disqualification; (5) no vehicle of any kind (car, bicycle, motorbike, ATV) in the event's perimeter. And, in the closing, one sentence: the name typed when signing electronically is the person's electronic signature, equivalent between them and the organiser to a handwritten one, and ticking the acceptance box accepts that mode (the group-run declaration already carries its own paragraph on the electronic signing, §523; the race's carried the eIDAS sentence only). **Decided without asking:** the disqualification is worded so it does not contradict the terms' refusal grounds (§618, §636): it rests «doar pe aceste motive obiective, iar organizatorul mi le comunică», sits beside the terms' §4 («oprit sau exclus pe loc») and carries the law's limit on its own sentence, as every sentence that takes a right away does (art. 1355 Codul civil; art. 1203 asks the express acceptance the terms' box already gives for §4); the vehicle clause says «în afara locurilor indicate de organizator», because a runner arrives by car and the platform cannot tell a parking from the perimeter; three of the five name the event by its blank, `{{event}}`, and no clause names a place, a date, a number or the club (§357). **Template only:** the texts in force do not move (§29, §95); the maintenance job's first run after the release emails the Administrators once (§639, `/admin/legal` marks the declarations «Șablon nou»); **a Romanian lawyer reads the five before the club approves them — the disqualification clause and the signature sentence first.** The declaration, once signed, is up to four pages (the layout test says so).

**B. The trace.** One expand-only migration, `0158_declaration_signature_trace` (journal position 151, after the group-run minor's `0155`; `batch/2026-10-14-bm`, landed as BR-V3.29, already holds `0156` and `0157`, so this one is renumbered `0158` and its snapshot still follows `0155`'s on this branch (the snapshot-chain test needs that) — `yarn batch:merge` of the batch rebuilds the journal and relinks the snapshot behind `0157`), adds `ip` and `user_agent` (text, nullable) to `declaration_acceptances` and to `group_run_declarations`, and `agreement_ip`, `agreement_user_agent`, `guardian_ip`, `guardian_user_agent` to `event_volunteers` — **the volunteer agreement's acceptance has no row of its own: it is columns of the volunteer's row (§758, §768)**, the volunteer's own on the form («FORM») or the emailed link («LINK»), the guardian's on theirs («LINK»); three tables, eight columns. Written at an **electronic** acceptance only — `EMAIL_LINK` on the race's row, always on a group run's (its page is the only road), `FORM` and `LINK` on the volunteer's, `LINK` on the guardian's — and **never on paper**: the one rule is `signature-trace.ts#traceColumns`, which every writer calls with its method, so a paper writer drops a trace passed to it (`PAPER` is a staff member recording a sheet the person signed by hand; the staff member's address says nothing about the signer, GDPR art. 5(1)(c)), and a test calls the race's writer with a trace beside `PAPER` and finds null. **Read the house way:** the action reads the first entry of `x-forwarded-for` (what the contact form's and the sign-ups' Turnstile checks already read; Vercel sets it, a client cannot prepend to it) and the `user-agent`, through `readSignatureTrace(await headers())` — never a form box, never a literal; a value that is not an IP address (`node:net` `isIP`) is dropped, the browser string is printable ASCII, one line, at most 300 characters (a header a proxy let a line feed through would break a PDF line; a letter outside the PDF's Roboto subset would print as a box); a missing header is null. Passed down as `trace` in `declarationSigningSchema` (the race), in `GroupRunSigningInput`, and as a trailing argument of `submitVolunteer`, `acceptVolunteerAgreementByLink` and `acceptVolunteerGuardianByLink`. **Retention unchanged, deleted with the row** (the columns are the row's: the race's erase, a group-run erase and a volunteer's delete are tested to leave nothing; the retention sweeps and the volunteers' thirty days delete whole rows, as they did). **«Toate datele unei persoane»** lists them: the race's acceptances already listed every column; the volunteers' offers now carry the four trace columns and the page prints them; and — a gap found on the way — **a group run's declarations were not on that page at all**, so its section «Declarații de alergare de grup» is new, the rows found by the canonical address (the rows keep the address as typed, so the addresses are read and each canonicalized in the process — an Administrator's rare request, a table of a club's signatures) and the export's audit row counts them. **The fingerprint (§556) is untouched:** the trace is not part of the text signed, so `text_hash` and the proof line are what they were. **Not gated** (the brief: nothing is gated; no `/admin/tasks` row): the trace is kept from the first signing after the release, whatever notice is in force — the privacy notice's template says it, the club approves it in the same sitting as the declarations (`docs/RUNBOOKS.md`); see the owner's question below. **The privacy notice's template:** in the declaration's paragraph, «nu și adresa IP» (which would now be untrue) becomes one sentence: if you sign electronically, we keep with the signed declaration the IP address and the browser you sign from, as they are at the moment of signing, as proof of the signature, for as long as we keep the declaration (section 7); for a signature on paper we keep nothing of the kind — and, because the same trace is kept on the two other rows, a clause each in the group run's paragraph and in the volunteers' paragraph (the volunteer's and the guardian's acceptance). AGENTS.md §10.8's «no raw IP/user-agent stored by default» now names this one exception.

**C. The PDF's signature block.** The typed name was already set large in the handwriting face — Caveat, the site's own, OFL, `src/theme/pdf/Caveat-Regular.ttf` with its licence beside it, self-hosted and embedded in pdfkit since §95 and §225 — so **no font file and no dependency is added**; the name stays at 26 points. Under the signature and its date, small (8 points, muted), one line: «Semnat electronic la 24.09.2026, 18:05:12 (ora României) · IP 203.0.113.9 · <browser>» / «Signed electronically on … (Romania time) · IP … · …» — the instant to the second as the proof line prints it, the parts the row does not hold left out with their separators; then the method line, the version and the sha256, and the proof line, as today. **One function draws it** — `renderDeclarationPdf`'s `drawEntry`, which the race's declaration, the group run's and the volunteer agreement's PDFs all hand their entries to (`signature.trace`, composed by `declarationTraceLine`/`signatureTraceLine`); no third copy. A paper acceptance, a row from before the trace, one that arrived without either header and the blank form print today's block (the method line already says «Semnat electronic …»). A minor beside a parent (§330, §769) gets the one line under both typed names (one press, one trace); the volunteer's own and the guardian's entries each carry their own. The block's room is asked for with the block, so it moves whole to the next page.

**Refused.** Gating the trace on the notice naming it (the brief says not; asked below); storing a trace for a paper signature, or taking a form box's value for it; any entry of `x-forwarded-for` past the first, a hostname or an address as a literal; a separate PDF function per document, a second handwriting font, a font fetched at render time; folding the trace into the signed text's hash (it is evidence beside the text, not part of it); writing the five clauses as a second text beside the declaration or only in the trail's; naming the club, a place or a number in a clause.

**For the owner and the lawyer.** (1) The trace is kept from the first signing after this release, before the club approves a notice that says so; the old notice in force says «nu și adresa IP». If the owner wants it, it is one switch: keep the IP only while the notice in force names it (the pattern of §562, §613), at the price of an `/admin/tasks` row. (2) The lawyer reads: the notice's section 10, whose «platforma nu stochează nicio adresă IP» became «singura adresă IP pe care o păstrăm este cea a unei semnături electronice»; the disqualification clause («fără drept de contestare în limitele permise de lege», objective grounds, told); the signature sentence («aceleași efecte ca o semnătură olografă», by agreement between the person and the organiser); the notice's sentence on the IP address (art. 6(1)(f), proof of the signature, as long as the declaration, three years).

**Review round (2026-10-14, after an adversarial review).** The guardian's IP address and browser are cleared with the rest of the guardian's columns when an organizer corrects an age to eighteen or more (tested); the notice's section 10 no longer says no IP address is stored; the declaration's «Semnez personal» list names the IP address and the browser among what is recorded together, and the English text says «volunteers» throughout; `callerIp` drops an address longer than the column and the schema allow; `consumeAndSignDeclaration`'s input type carries `trace`; a source guard pins that the five electronic actions read the trace from the request; the AGENTS.md §10.8 rule names every electronic road, and the approval step for the notice moves to the day of the release. **Declined:** dropping «Semnat electronic» from the method line when the trace line is drawn (the trace line is worded as the brief asked, the method line is §418's); folding the signature sentence into the «Semnez personal» paragraph (the owner asked for a sentence of its own; the lawyer may fold it).
changelogLine: - **Five more clauses in the race declaration; the signature's trace** — the declaration's template (trail and road, both languages) gains medical insurance, the marked route and the volunteers' instructions, disqualification without appeal on objective grounds, litter, and no vehicle in the perimeter, plus one sentence that the typed name is the electronic signature; the texts in force do not move until the club approves them (a lawyer reads the five first). An electronic signature now keeps the IP address and browser of the press — on the race's declaration, a group run's and the volunteer agreement's (the volunteer's and the guardian's) — never on paper, printed small under the signature of the PDF («Semnat electronic la … · IP … · …») and listed, with the group run's declarations, in «Toate datele unei persoane». The privacy notice's template says so. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 3. Given an acceptance by email link, when it is stored, then the IP address and the browser of the request that carried the signature are stored with it (`declaration_acceptances.ip`, `user_agent`: the first entry of `x-forwarded-for`, kept only when it is an IP address, and the `user-agent` as printable ASCII of at most 300 characters; null for a missing header) as the proof of the electronic signature; given a paper acceptance, they are never stored, whatever the caller passes; they are kept as long as the row and deleted with it, retention unchanged (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `registrations/signature-trace.test.ts`; unit `legal-documents/signature-trace.test.ts`.

Given a group run's declaration signed on the run's page, when the row is written, then it keeps the same trace (`group_run_declarations.ip`, `user_agent`); given a volunteer's acceptance of the agreement on the form or from the emailed link, and a guardian's on theirs, then the volunteer's row keeps `agreement_ip` / `agreement_user_agent` and `guardian_ip` / `guardian_user_agent`, and a paper acceptance (`PAPER`) keeps none; a migration (`0158_declaration_signature_trace`) adds the eight nullable text columns of the three tables and only expands (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `group-run-declarations/signature-trace.test.ts`, `volunteers/signature-trace.test.ts`, `db/declaration-signature-trace-migration.test.ts`.

Given a signed declaration of an event, a group run or a volunteer, when its PDF is drawn, then the typed name is set large in the handwriting face (Caveat, embedded) and, under the signature and its date, one small line «Semnat electronic la <instant to the second> (ora României) · IP <address> · <browser>» («Signed electronically on … (Romania time) · IP … · …» in English) follows from the row's trace, the parts not kept left out, before the version, the sha256 and the proof line; a paper acceptance, a row from before the trace and the blank form print the block as before; a minor beside a parent (§330, §769) gets the one line under both typed names, and the volunteer's own and the guardian's entries each their own; one renderer, `renderDeclarationPdf`, draws it for the three documents (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `registrations/declaration-trace-pdf.test.ts`; integration `registrations/signature-trace.test.ts`, `volunteers/signature-trace.test.ts`, `group-run-declarations/signature-trace.test.ts`.

Given the platform's two race declarations (the trail's and the road's), in both languages, then each carries, among the shared duties and in this order, the five clauses — valid medical insurance or the medical costs borne in full; the marked route followed and the organiser's and the volunteers' instructions respected, the organiser being able to stop or disqualify; disqualification without appeal «în limitele permise de lege» on objective grounds the organiser tells, for leaving the marked route, unsporting behaviour or breaking the rules; litter in the event's area a ground of disqualification; no vehicle of any kind in the event's perimeter — and, in the closing, one sentence that the typed name is the person's electronic signature, equivalent to a handwritten one, and ticking the box accepts that mode; none names the club, a place, a date or a number (the event is `{{event}}`), «voluntari» and never «arbitri»; the change moves the template only (the texts in force do not move) and the maintenance job's notice to the Administrators fires once (§639) (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `legal-documents/declaration-clauses.test.ts`; integration `legal/declaration-clauses-notice.test.ts`.

Given the privacy notice's template, in both languages, then the declaration's paragraph says that, when a person signs electronically, the IP address and the browser at the moment of signing are kept with the signed declaration as proof of the signature, as long as the declaration, and that a paper signature keeps nothing of the kind — it no longer says that the IP address is not kept — and the group run's paragraph and the volunteers' paragraph (the volunteer's and the guardian's acceptance) say the same of their own rows; no marker is added and no `/admin/tasks` row waits on it (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `legal-documents/declaration-clauses.test.ts`.

Given «Toate datele unei persoane» (the page and its JSON file) for an address, then the race acceptances carry the IP address and the browser kept with them, the volunteer offers carry the four trace columns of the agreement's and the guardian's acceptance, and the group-run declarations signed with that address — found by the canonical form, the row kept as typed — are listed with their typed names, the identity document, the version and the trace; the export's audit row counts them and names no value (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `registrations/signature-trace.test.ts`, `volunteers/signature-trace.test.ts`, `group-run-declarations/signature-trace.test.ts`, `registrations/person-data.test.ts`.
